title: 第528章 小心要钱第527章 系统升级
lines: “怎么会这样？”
无极界空间节点上空，九重天上有一个人正露出一副奇怪的表情。
他的视野当中，整片天地都有着数之不尽密密麻麻的丝线。
这些是因果线，因为他领悟了因果大道。
他伸手拨开大量因果线，最终捏住属于无极界的那一根。
“只剩一根了。”
李寻额头冒出冷汗。
他只是因为参悟了因果大道，所以外出逛逛实验自己所悟。
没想到一出门就发现足以震惊世界的状况。
按正常情况，这世界任何事物都不可能只有一根因果线。
除非这个东西是附属物，因果线全在它的主人身上。
所以答案只有一个。
无极界已经被悄无声息炼化，或许就连其中的成仙之机也已不知所踪。
此事干系太大，而他突破至今也才两三个轮回，界主境里都属于小角色。
叹息一声，李寻顺着因果线开始推算吉凶。
他算了七件事，全部都只算吉凶，因为他知道更深层次他算不出来。
一连得到七个‘凶’，他已经满头大汗。
一阵思索过后，他低语道：“如果此人真能成仙，那便由得他去吧，至少不会对整个世界造成严重后果。
倘若他在成仙之前被发现才是真的祸事。”
说罢，他开始发功掩盖天机，甚至是伪造因果线。
不为别的，为了天下苍生。
一场界主境大战，这天下不知会有多少无辜生灵会被波及而死。
做完力所能及的事情，他摇头叹息着走了。
就在他走后没多久，一道红袍身影来到他离开的位置。
李寻还不知道，刚才有把刀已经架在他脖子上，一个不慎就会死翘翘。
小心望着无极界的核心皱眉，好一阵过后她掏出一套扰乱天机的阵法，随后更是加入功德之力让其伪造的天机更为真实。
无奈，她不会卜算之法，所能做到的也就这些了。
“时间，我还需要时间。”
她一个闪现离开了，再出现时已经来到老祖身旁。
“爷爷！”她表情切换自然，如往常一般热情的张开双臂。
老祖不疑有他，只当孙女这次闭关收获很大，所以耽误的时间多了些。
小心如往常一样，很快又逮住冬冬一阵揉搓，老祖则是进屋去做菜了。
冬冬的脸被搓圆搓扁，然后痴痴呆呆挤出一句：“姐…姐姐，身上…香香的。”
“哈哈哈，弟弟鼻子怎么这么灵。”她喜爱的抱住冬冬蹭脸，眼里满是亲情爱意。
打小她就喜欢这弟弟，虽然他不仅不会长大还经常智商欠费。
其实老祖对她的记忆封锁早就解开，所以她早就知道冬冬救过自己一命。
虽然就算没有冬冬，老祖也会及时赶到，但那也是不争的事实。
一顿晚饭过后，老祖又提着鱼竿来到海边钓鱼。
小心抱着冬冬一起跟了过来在旁边坐，冬冬就专注玩着手里的小霸王游戏机。
老祖道：“小心要不要钓鱼，这会儿海里全是奇形怪状的鱼。”
content_en:
"How could this happen?"
Over the space node of Wuji Realm, there is a person in the Nine Heavens showing a strange expression.
In his field of vision, the entire world was filled with countless densely packed threads.
These are the lines of cause and effect, because he understood the avenue of cause and effect.
He stretched out his hand to push through a large number of causal threads, and finally pinched the one that belonged to the Wuji Realm.
"Only one left."
Cold sweat broke out on Li Xun's forehead.
He simply understood the path of cause and effect, so he went out to experiment with what he had understood.
Unexpectedly, as soon as I stepped out, I would find a situation that would shock the world.
Under normal circumstances, nothing in this world can have only one causal line.
Unless this thing is an accessory, the causal line lies entirely with its owner.
So there is only one answer.
The Wuji Realm has been quietly refined, and perhaps even the opportunity to become an immortal has been lost.
The stakes in this matter are too great, and he has only been in two or three reincarnations since his breakthrough, so he is a minor player in the Realm of Realm.
"Alas."
With a sigh, Li Xun followed the line of cause and effect and began to calculate good and bad luck.
He calculated seven things, all of which were only good or bad, because he knew that he could not calculate deeper things.
He was sweating profusely after getting seven 'fierce' ones in a row.
After thinking for a while, he whispered: "If this person can really become an immortal, then let him go, at least it will not cause serious consequences to the entire world.
It would be a real disaster if he was discovered before he became an immortal. "
After that, he began to use his powers to cover up the secrets, and even forged causal lines.
Not for anything else, but for the common people in the world.
In a battle in the Realm of the Realm, I don’t know how many innocent creatures in this world will be affected and die.
After doing what he could, he shook his head and left with a sigh.
Not long after he left, a figure in red robe came to the place where he left.
Li Xun didn't know it yet, but a knife had been placed on his neck just now. If he was not careful, he would die.
Carefully looking at the core of Wuji Realm and frowning, after a while she took out a set of formations to disrupt the secrets of heaven, and then added the power of merit to make the forged secrets of heaven more real.
Unfortunately, she doesn't know how to predict things, so that's all she can do.
"Time, I still need time."
She left in a flash, and when she reappeared, she was already at the ancestor's side.
"Grandpa!" Her expression changed naturally, and she opened her arms enthusiastically as usual.
The ancestor did not doubt that he was there, but thought that his granddaughter had gained a lot from this retreat, so she wasted a lot of time.
Being careful as usual, he quickly caught Dongdong and rubbed him while the ancestor went into the house to cook.
Dongdong's face was rounded and flattened, and then she muttered out in a daze: "Sister...sister, you smell...smells."
"Hahaha, why is my brother's nose so sharp?" She hugged Dongdong and rubbed her face lovingly, her eyes full of affection.
She has liked this brother since she was a child, even though he not only never grows up but also often falls short of his IQ.
In fact, the ancestor's memory blockade on her had been released long ago, so she had long known that Dongdong had saved her life.
Although the ancestor would have arrived in time even if there was no Dongdong, that is an indisputable fact.
After dinner, the ancestor went to the beach to fish again with his fishing rod.
Xiao Xin hugged Dongdong and followed him over, sitting next to him. Dongdong focused on playing the Little Overlord game console in his hand.
The ancestor said: "Be careful if you go fishing, the sea is full of strange fish at the moment."
